source.title: How Slum Redevelopment Is Changing Mumbai
source.description:
Slum rehabilitation is changing Mumbai’s skyline. With 40+ storey towers being built in places where dense settlements once stood.

But this isn’t just about construction. It’s about creating a potential win-win model for residents, developers and the city.

source_evidence_points: Underutilized horizontal land footprints are consolidated into vertical high-density structures to free up valuable urban space.
High-margin open-market commercial/luxury spaces cross-subsidize redevelopment costs and public infrastructure improvements.
Density optimization reclaims urban land without requiring direct state capital outlays while modernizing surroundings.
Coexistence of high-density upgraded developments alongside core urban land boosts overall micro-market valuation.
pack.source_script_insight: The source demonstrates how Mumbai's SRA model uses high-density vertical development and open-market cross-subsidization to convert low-efficiency urban slums into high-value assets while upgrading local infrastructure.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In Coimbatore's core commercial corridors like Gandhipuram and DB Road, high land costs make horizontal development inefficient. Leveraging vertical density and cross-subsidization allows investors and developers to turn underutilized low-rise properties into high-yielding commercial assets that elevate surrounding land values.
pack.visual_strategy: Show physical visual contrasts between underutilized horizontal rooflines in central Coimbatore and modern multi-storey commercial density. Use real-world architectural site plans, street-level infrastructural upgrades, and elevated skyline views to demonstrate how cross-subsidized density creates commercial appreciation.
pack.core_takeaway: Vertical cross-subsidization unlocks maximum land value in high-density urban nodes.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK
- Duration: Exactly 10.0 seconds total.
- Aspect Ratio: Native Portrait 9:16 (1080x1920 pixels).
- Composition: Vertical full-screen frame throughout. Zero letterboxing, zero black sidebars, zero horizontal frame-in-frame composition.
- Location Focus: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu ONLY.

B. REALISM LOCK
- Must look like 100% photorealistic digital cinema video shot on location in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.
- Natural midday to late-afternoon sunlight (5000K daylight), realistic physical textures (weathered brick, concrete dust, modern curtain-wall glass, asphalt roads).
- Real Tamil Nadu urban environment: authentic local streetscapes, real store signages in Tamil, realistic local vehicles, and distant Western Ghats atmospheric haze.
- NO animation, NO 3D CAD renders, NO architectural visualization, NO cartoon/toon graphics, NO CGI plastic aesthetic.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK
- Subject: Redevelopment Economics & Cross-Subsidization (Derived from SRA urban economic mechanism).
- Core Lesson: High-density vertical development in dense urban nodes generates high commercial value that cross-subsidizes redevelopment costs and upgrades surrounding micro-market land values.
- Coimbatore Application: In dense central zones like Gandhipuram and RS Puram, transitioning underutilized ground footprints into vertical high-density commercial/mixed-use assets drives exponential return on land.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY
- Focus exclusively on physical mechanics of urban density, FSI optimization, street-level infrastructure, and commercial conversion.
- Strictly forbidden: Generic plot-to-villa construction sequences, family moving into homes, or generic real estate handheld signboards.

E. CAMERA + IMAGE QUALITY
- Filmed on 35mm and 50mm cinema lenses, crisp focus, natural depth of field, steady camera motion, stable geometry, realistic exposure without crushed shadows or blown highlights.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT PLAN (10.0 SECONDS TOTAL)

- Shot 1 (0.0s - 1.4s) | Gandhipuram Urban Core
  - Subject: Tightly packed older low-rise commercial structures with tin and clay tile roofs.
  - Framing: High-angle vertical downward view looking into a narrow commercial lane.
  - Motion: Slow downward vertical drift.
  - Lighting: Bright midday tropical sunlight creating crisp shadows between tight buildings.
  - Overlay Text: "நிலப் பயன்பாடு"
  - Tamil VO: "நகர மையத்தில் குறைந்த பயன்பாட்டு நிலம்..."

- Shot 2 (1.4s - 2.8s) | Density Shift
  - Subject: Low-rise brick shop wall transitioning into a modern 8-storey commercial glass tower in Coimbatore.
  - Framing: Ground-level upward vertical tilt shot.
  - Motion: Smooth vertical tilt from ground level up to the skyward edge of the building.
  - Lighting: Direct clear sunlight reflecting off structural glass and aluminum composite panels.
  - Overlay Text: "அடர்த்தி மாற்றம்"
  - Tamil VO: "...உயர் அடர்த்தி கட்டிடங்களால் மாறுகிறது!"

- Shot 3 (2.8s - 4.2s) | High-Value Retail Storefront
  - Subject: High-end retail interior visible through a ground-floor glass showroom in Coimbatore.
  - Framing: Medium shot at eye level through clean window glass.
  - Motion: Slow tracking pan across the storefront exterior.
  - Lighting: Warm interior display lighting contrasting with natural exterior daylight.
  - Overlay Text: "பிரீமியம் பகுதி"
  - Tamil VO: "பிரீமியம் வணிகப் பகுதிகள்..."

- Shot 4 (4.2s - 5.6s) | Financial & Structural Documentation
  - Subject: Architect desk with printed Coimbatore master plan blueprints, Floor Space Index (FSI) density charts, and a physical scientific calculator.
  - Framing: Top-down macro close-up insert shot.
  - Motion: Static precise macro focus.
  - Lighting: Soft office daylight from side window.
  - Overlay Text: "கிராஸ் சப்சிடி"
  - Tamil VO: "...அடிப்படை மறுசீரமைப்புச் செலவை ஈடுகட்டுகின்றன!"

- Shot 5 (5.6s - 7.0s) | Infrastructure Upgrade
  - Subject: Newly paved asphalt street, concrete storm drainage curb, and neat underground utility access along DB Road corridor.
  - Framing: Low-angle tracking shot along pavement edge.
  - Motion: Forward dolly along the newly upgraded street edge.
  - Lighting: Warm afternoon sun highlighting asphalt texture.
  - Overlay Text: "நகர தரம்"
  - Tamil VO: "நகர உள்கட்டமைப்பு தரம் பெறுகிறது."

- Shot 6 (7.0s - 8.4s) | Skyline Appreciation
  - Subject: Panoramic vista of Coimbatore urban canopy showing modernized commercial towers standing beside traditional green residential plots.
  - Framing: Elevated smooth drone shot looking towards RS Puram.
  - Motion: Gentle forward camera drift.
  - Lighting: Late afternoon golden hour lighting with clear atmospheric sky.
  - Overlay Text: "மதிப்பு உயர்வு"
  - Tamil VO: "சுற்றியுள்ள சொத்து மதிப்பு உயர்கிறது!"

- Shot 7 (8.4s - 10.0s) | Final Investment Context
  - Subject: Wide view of modern Coimbatore urban development framed against distant blue silhouettes of Western Ghats mountains at sunset.
  - Framing: Eye-level static vista shot.
  - Motion: Completely static frame.
  - Lighting: Warm sunset glow over city buildings.
  - Overlay Text: "OliveTree Investors"
  - Tamil VO: "கோவை நகர்ப்புற மறுவளர்ச்சியை கணக்கிடுங்கள்!"

G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT
- Overlay text must be minimalist 1-2 words in crisp white sans-serif font placed in lower third with subtle dark drop shadow.
- NO cartoon speech bubbles, NO floating 3D graphic arrows, NO neon outline overlays.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE
- Ends on real-world photorealistic cityscape of Coimbatore under evening light with minimal brand text overlay "OliveTree Investors". No graphic end-cards.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT / FIXED RULES
- Strictly ban: 2D/3D cartoon animation, architectural 3D renders, video-game engine footage, plastic CGI surfaces, fake non-Coimbatore skylines, morphing graphics, garbled text, duplicated citizens, visible camera operator, religious icons, ceremonial banners, horizontal 16:9 bar framing, speed ramping, fisheye distortion, and generic happy families receiving keys.
